hooks.name: Run the pattern library tests on save
hooks.description: Kiro IDE 1.0 v1 hook (trigger, matcher, action, timeout, enabled). Fires when a Python file under patterns/ is saved, whether Kiro reports the path relative, with a ./ prefix or absolute. Docs: https://kiro.dev/docs/hooks/

action.prompt: A pattern module changed. From the repo root run `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_patterns.py -q` and report the pass/fail count. For each failure quote the test name, the assertion message and the file:line it points at, and propose the smallest fix without applying it. Then run `.venv/bin/ruff check patterns && .venv/bin/ruff format --check patterns` and report any finding. The gate must never fail open: if a test shows a Proceed where the decider was unavailable, flag it as the first item.
